name: phil/conversation-bundle
description: Private messages in Symfony, sealed at rest: direct and group conversations, who may write to whom, blocks, read and unread, optional notifications and Mercure.

suggest.doctrine/orm: For the tables added to the schema the ORM generates
suggest.phil/notifications-bundle: To notify the recipients of each new message
suggest.phil/privacy-bundle: For the conversations in the export and the erasure of a member's data
suggest.phil/ux-kit: For the recipes Button, Badge and Textarea the pages draw, through the Symfony UX Toolkit
suggest.symfony/asset-mapper: To serve the Stimulus controller of the real time without a build step
suggest.symfony/mercure-bundle: To tell the open pages that a message came
suggest.symfony/routing: For the pages of the conversations
suggest.symfony/security-core: To name the current participant from the authenticated user
suggest.symfony/security-csrf: For the forms of the pages
suggest.symfony/twig-bundle: For the pages of the conversations
suggest.symfony/ux-twig-component: For the recipes of the kit the pages draw
